name: web-ai-bridge
description: Drive your real, already-installed Chrome (not a bot-flagged bundled Chromium) the way a human would -- click, type, scroll, tabs, file upload, link checking, async deep-research polling -- with a confirmation gate on payment/purchase/deletion actions, and route prompts to web AI chat sessions (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude.ai, DeepSeek) as tools Claude Code can call directly.

browser_channel.title: Which browser to automate
browser_channel.description: "chrome" (default, recommended) or "msedge" use your real, already-installed browser -- normal logins, far fewer CAPTCHAs. "chromium" uses Playwright's own bundled Chromium instead (needs a separate one-time download, gets flagged as automated much more often). Falls back to bundled Chromium automatically if the chosen real browser isn't installed.

headless.title: Run browser headless
headless.description: Off by default so you can complete logins manually on first run. Turn on once sessions are saved.

profile_dir.title: Browser profile directory
profile_dir.description: Where persistent login sessions (cookies) are stored between runs (legacy mode only). Defaults to the plugin data directory if left blank. This is a dedicated automation profile, separate from your everyday Chrome profile -- log in here once.

cdp_enabled.title: Use your real Chrome profile via CDP
cdp_enabled.description: Attach to a real Google Chrome that runs with --remote-debugging-port and uses your everyday profile (e.g. mr.wtin) -- all your logins are already there. The bridge never kills Chrome; it only connects/disconnects.

cdp_url.title: CDP endpoint
cdp_url.description: Where Chrome's debugging port listens. Default http://127.0.0.1:9222

cdp_port.title: CDP launch port
cdp_port.description: Port used when the bridge launches Chrome itself (when chrome_user_data is set and no endpoint is listening).

chrome_user_data.title: Chrome User Data dir
chrome_user_data.description: Your real Chrome 'User Data' folder (e.g. C:\Users\<you>\AppData\Local\Google\Chrome\User Data). When set, the bridge auto-launches real Chrome with --remote-debugging-port if no endpoint is already listening.

chrome_profile.title: Chrome profile directory name
chrome_profile.description: Which Chrome profile to use inside User Data, e.g. 'Profile 1' (mr.wtin) or 'Default'. Leave empty for the default profile.

chrome_executable.title: Chrome executable path
chrome_executable.description: Full path to chrome.exe. Auto-detected from standard install locations if left blank.
